name: Retro Export
description: Thin wrapper that exports gstack /retro metrics as JSON schema v1.0 for downstream tooling (dashboards, reporting agents) to consume.
author: Soren (Cast Iron Forge)

outputs.retroJson: JSON schema v1.0 written to %APPDATA%\Claude\retro-export.json (Windows) or ~/.config/Claude/retro-export.json

errorConditions.handler: returns { success: false, error } instead of throwing

tooltip: Exports gstack /retro metrics as stable JSON schema v1.0 for downstream tooling.
